items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 6849.14/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-04-25 was Rs 6849.14/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1516.33-10000.0/MWh).
